name: Spark Scan
summary: Scan pages from the glass or the feeder, crop them, and save one PDF (searchable, if you want) or an image per page.
summary_fr: Numériser des pages depuis la vitre ou le chargeur, les recadrer, et enregistrer un PDF (cherchable, si vous voulez) ou une image par page.

optional.tesseract: searchable PDFs (English and French language data)
optional.PIL.ImageTk: faster drawing of pages (without it, Tk reads PNG data)
optional.xdg-user-dir: finding the Documents folder when it isn't ~/Documents

needs.system: SANE (sane-backends) with a backend for the scanner: pixma and airscan cover Canon printers on USB and Wi-Fi
